text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
I shall carve my very first hoofprints. 
Upon the grounds of Sapporo—

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Witnesses ripe for intoxication. A boiling 
impulse for destruction! How delightfully 
sweet a maiden battle is!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Our legend begins with this debut race! 
Now, let us drink deep of this bold, vivid 
new wine!
